protocol.purpose: Cross-year test re-evaluation of all 105 completed v4-v7 runs and 15 paired baseline checkpoints
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Original per-run best farm-macro MAE on frozen 2023 validation set
protocol.cohort: Frozen original 55 farms; no new exclusions
protocol.test_origins: All 27982 origins from existing daily protocol test cache; original November exclusion retained
protocol.metrics: Mean over 55 farm MAEs and farm RMSEs, then equal mean over 5 seeds; high power uses origin >= 0.75
protocol.inference: FP32, TF32 off, original K=8 stateless samples and original 8-step flow integration
